text:
Rina V.: opened PR to update model catalog entries for q4/q8 variants and add a short migration guide + explicit limits: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5110 :wave:
Omar B.: can you include exact machine/precision columns for the perf table? customers want repro details (e.g., a100-80gb / fp16, a100-40gb / q8).
Rina V.: yep adding an "instance / precision" column and linking the raw CSV. Also adding a brief note that 8-bit KV is experimental.
Hannah T.: quick PSA: the SDK snippet on the card still has `client.generate()`; CI will fail unless we switch to `client.text.generate()` and add snippet markers. Pushing a tiny commit to the PR branch.
bench-bot: upload complete: aether-7b-q8 - a100-40gb - runs [1,8,16] - median p95: 35ms, 58ms, 72ms. CSV: s3://bench-uploads/5110/aether7b_q8.csv
Omar B.: for the catalog table use median p95 and add a "notes" column recommending batch <=16. Also call out unstable tail at batch 32.
Hannah T.: proposing migration examples under "Migration":

```
# old (un-pinned)
resp = client.generate(model="aether-7b-q8", input=prompt)

# new (pin variant)
resp = client.text.generate(model="aether-7b@q8-2026-03-01", input=prompt, max_tokens=512)
```

Hannah T.: plus a short CLI example and SNIPPET markers: `SNIPPET_START:cli-q-migrate` / `SNIPPET_END`.
docs-bot: linkcheck error: /model-catalog/aether-7b -> 404 (branch: rina/quantized-update).
Rina V.: I moved the card to `model-catalog/cards/` while reorganizing; fixing the link now.
ci-bot: docs build failed - missing snippet marker `SNIPPET_START:sdk-py-q` in model-card/aether-7b.md.
Hannah T.: added both Python + Node markers. Python uses `client.text.generate(...)` and Node uses `client.text.generate(...)` as well. Kept examples minimal.
bench-bot: updated CSV after small change: s3://bench-uploads/5110/aether7b_q8_v2.csv (re-run with snippet changes).
Omar B.: wording suggestion for compatibility note: "Quantized variants prioritize throughput; some runtime features (streaming long contexts, certain function-calling patterns) are limited or experimental. Pin model variant to lock behavior."
Rina V.: added compatibility table row: `Quantized variant | Streaming: limited | Function-calls: partial | Long-context KV: experimental`. Kept conservative language.
Hannah T.: CI preview deployed: https://deploy-preview--docs.redwood.ai/model-catalog/aether-7b (branch: rina/quantized-update)
docs-bot: preview shows one broken internal link from the migration doc to /sdk/migration - absolute should be relative.
Rina V.: fixing link to ../sdk/migration and pushing.
ci-bot: build passed (job #2489) on branch rina/quantized-update.
Omar B.: quick pass on phrasing, pushed a tiny grammar tweak. Looks good to merge once Sam re-runs the final bench attach.
Rina V.: Sam (bench owner) attached final CSV and numbers, merging now. Thanks all.
Hannah T.: merged and backported snippet markers to stable branch. Closing. :tada:
